note: One run per doctrine scenario, same commit, shipped defaults, seed 12. Sealed by scripts/baseline.py --seal once the fleet lands; audited by scripts/baseline.py.

referenced_history.squad_nomask_v1: B3 ablation arm on THIS cohort/ tree: orders kept, doctrine masks removed. Read against squad_v10, which is the full arm and a baseline member.
referenced_history.squad_flat_v1: B3 ablation arm on THIS cohort/ tree: no orders at all, every agent gets the OPORD direct.
referenced_history.squad_abl_full_s3: B3 2026-08-06, Box(137): the three-seed original. Kept because one seed per arm is what its v1.19 replication has, and the older result is the stronger evidence on the axes it measured.
referenced_history.squad_abl_flat_s3: B3 2026-08-06, Box(137): the flat arm of that original — the 2.2x wipe rate the robustness claim rests on.
referenced_history.squad_v10b: Confirmation seed (13) for the flagship squad scenario. squad_v10 published at 0.92 ± 0.05 against squad_v8's 0.98 ± 0.03 and squad_v9's 0.97 ± 0.03 — overlapping intervals, Fisher p = 0.10 and 0.21, so not a difference by this repo's own rule, but at the low end of the band with root death 0.30 vs 0.23/0.18 (p = 0.34 / 0.068). One seed cannot say whether that is the scenario or the draw; two can bound it. The manifest member stays seed 12 either way, because it is also the ablation's control arm and the three arms must share a seed.
